summary: The direct Tower2 load first diverges because the C reset path removes monsters from the current level before the Lua alignment shuffle, while JavaScript skips that cleanup at a note_unported site. C reaches steal.c:mdrop_special_objs and zap.c:obj_resists for inventory objects, consuming rn2(100); JavaScript reaches the alignment shuffle and consumes rn2(3). The source owner is wizcmds.c:makemap_remove_mons and its static helper makemap_unmakemon, wired through the existing cmd.c:makemap_prepost pre path.

source.branch: On a wizard special-level reset, sp_lev.c:lspo_reset_level calls cmd.c:makemap_prepost with pre=true. That caller runs makemap_remove_mons before load_special initializes nhlib.lua and shuffles the level alignment table. makemap_remove_mons keeps eligible pets, uncreates ordinary and migrating monsters, and purges detached monsters; mongone reaches mdrop_special_objs, whose unconditional obj_resists call consumes rn2(100) for ordinary inventory objects even at zero resistance chance.
callers: C: wizcmds.c:wiz_load_splua -> sp_lev.c:lspo_reset_level -> cmd.c:makemap_prepost(pre=true) -> wizcmds.c:makemap_remove_mons -> wizcmds.c:makemap_unmakemon -> mon.c:mongone -> steal.c:mdrop_special_objs -> zap.c:obj_resists

JavaScript: js/wizcmds.js:wiz_load_splua -> js/mklev.js:lspo_reset_level -> js/cmd.js:makemap_prepost; the caller currently records note_unported("wizcmds.c makemap_remove_mons") instead of invoking a port
JavaScript: js/wizcmds.js:wiz_makemap -> js/cmd.js:makemap_prepost; the same caller wiring is shared
